$comment: Theme settings (ID4, IP4): the tokens a project may set from its theme, listed under the component that reads them. Set them with applySettings or settingsCss from @design-library/core/theme, or in your theme stylesheet on :root or a template's root. Every other --c-* token stays private. Values should read tokens (var(--space-…)) or be a length; the library keeps each default.

Shared.--border-divider: Horizontal separator width across lists, tables, accordions and layout headers/footers. Set 0px for no horizontal separators; field/control outlines, focus rings and selection indicators are unchanged. Dialog and MenuButton already use space, not dividers.

PropertySection.--c-property-section-divider-width: Optional horizontal separator between sections, absent by default. Set 0px to remove one enabled by a template.

SiteLayout.--c-site-layout-reading: The reading column's width (default the reading measure, 42rem).
SiteLayout.--c-site-layout-margin: The page margin on each column: header, main and footer content share it (default space.margin-page).
SiteLayout.--c-site-layout-gap: The space between the column's bands: hero, sections, call to action (default space.stack-page).
SiteLayout.--c-site-layout-padding-block: The space above the first band and under the last (default space.stack-page).
SiteLayout.--c-site-layout-padding-start: The space above the first band only; follows padding-block when not set. 0 puts the first band right under the header, as opening="flush" does.
SiteLayout.--c-site-layout-skip-radius: The skip link's corners while it shows on focus, in SiteLayout and LibraryLayout (default radius.none, square). Set var(--radius-md) to follow the controls' corners.

Footer.--c-footer-links-column-min: A two-column section (FooterSection.columns = 2): the narrowest a column of links gets before the section falls back to one column (default 8em). Short labels such as years can take less.

TextField.--c-applied-fill: An applied filter's fill on TextField, Select and SegmentedControl (applied); default color.accent-subtle.
TextField.--c-applied-border: An applied filter's outline on the same controls; default color.accent.

AppLayout.--c-app-layout-header-divider-width: A rule under the header (default 0px, none). Set var(--border-hairline) for an app whose bar is ruled off from the sidebar and the view.
AppLayout.--c-app-layout-head-gap: Between the view's head (its title, and headActions) and its content (default space.stack-page; size s a section's step). Set var(--space-8) for an editing app whose title sits a section's step over its first part (LR52).
AppLayout.--c-app-layout-margin: Around the view inside its scroller (default space.inset-md). Set var(--space-8) for an editing app whose screens sit further from the frame's edges (LR79).
AppLayout.--c-app-layout-end: Room under the view's last part, inside its scroller (default c.app-layout.margin, the same as its other sides). Set more for an editing app whose last field shouldn't sit at the window's edge (LR75).

StickyBar.--c-sticky-bar-padding-block: Above and below the bar's controls, at rest and stuck alike (default space.stack-item).

Switch.--c-switch-radius: The track's and thumb's corners (default radius.full, round ends at any shape). Set var(--radius-pill) so a theme's pill-ends choice reaches the switch.

Slider.--c-slider-radius: The track's, fill's, thumb's and step dots' corners (default radius.full, round at any shape). Set var(--radius-pill) so a theme's pill-ends choice reaches the slider.

Image.--c-image-reveal-duration: How long a drawn reveal (Image reveal, a template's reveal preset) takes from the picture to its pair (default duration.xslow, 400 ms). A brand whose reveal is a slow effect sets a longer time; reduced motion never draws it.
Image.--c-image-reveal-reduced-duration: With reduced motion a reveal isn't drawn: the pair crossfades in over the resting tone for this long (default duration.change, 200 ms). A brand whose approved reduced-motion fade is shorter or longer sets it.

ImageGrid.--c-image-grid-framed-gap: Between pictures in a framed grid (framed; a media block with its frame switch on). Default space.2, the usual gap: each picture keeps its art in its own box (Image room). A template whose framed pictures read crowded sets more.
ImageGrid.--c-image-grid-cell: A quilted grid's square cell (layout quilted): the narrowest a cell gets, so as many columns as fit (default 8rem). A template whose quilted pattern needs a fixed column count sets a share of the width with a floor, e.g. four: max(8rem, calc((100% - 3 * var(--c-image-grid-gap)) / 4 - 1px)).

List.--c-list-tile-min: An action list's tiles (layout tiles): the narrowest a tile gets before fewer fit across (default size.column-min). A catalogue in a narrow panel sets a smaller length.
List.--c-list-tile-fill: A tile's surface inside its hairline outline (default color.bg-control). A theme that draws tiles outlined on the page sets var(--color-bg); the outline stays the tile's boundary.
List.--c-list-tile-name-weight: A tile's name (default type.label.weight). A catalogue whose names lead its tiles sets var(--weight-bold) or var(--weight-semibold).
List.--c-list-tile-name-size: A tile's name (default type.label.size). A dense catalogue whose descriptions carry the detail sets a step smaller, such as var(--type-body-sm-size).
List.--c-list-tile-radius: A tile's corners (default radius.md, a control's). A theme whose surfaces are squarer sets var(--radius-sm).

PageGrid.--c-page-grid-empty-size: The least height of an empty cell (default 0: an empty cell takes no height). An editor's preview sets the height its canvas gives an empty cell, so a page previews with the layout it's edited in.
PageGrid.--c-page-grid-frame-inset: Above and below a framed row's content (LR129; default space.stack-section). A template whose bands have their own rhythm sets its band padding.
PageGrid.--c-page-grid-frame-gap: Between rows inside a framed row that leave their gap unset (LR129; default space.stack-group). A template sets its band's stack gap.
PageGrid.--c-page-grid-frame-fill: A tint frame's surface (LR129; default color.bg-sunken). A template sets its tint.
PageGrid.--c-page-grid-frame-fill-inset: A tint frame's inline inset (LR129; default space.inset-lg).
PageGrid.--c-page-grid-frame-radius: A tint frame's corners (LR129; default radius.md).
PageGrid.--c-page-grid-lead-start: A lead row's start column, as a grid track (LR132; default 1fr, the end column is always 1fr). A template sets its opening's words share, such as 0.44fr.
PageGrid.--c-page-grid-lead-pull: How far a lead row is pulled up into the space above it (LR132; default 0). A template whose opening meets the header sets its page top.
PageGrid.--c-page-grid-lead-bleed: How far a lead row's columns run past the column's end (LR132; default 0); the rows under them stay in the column.
PageGrid.--c-page-grid-lead-lift: Between a lead row's two columns and each row under them (LR132; default space.stack-group).
PageGrid.--c-page-grid-lead-stack-gap: Between a lead row's columns once they stack (LR132; default space.stack-section).
PageGrid.--c-page-grid-split-gutter: Between the cells of a split row (gutter split, LR135; default space.gutter). A template sets its two-column band's gap, such as its fluid column gap.

ScreenPreview.--c-screen-preview-desktop: The least width a screen is laid out at with width desktop, scaled down to fit a narrower window (default 80rem, 1280 px). A canvas that shows small text sets a narrower desktop (64rem) for a larger scale.

Section.--c-section-gap: Between a section's head (heading and intro) and its content (default space.stack-section). A theme whose page gap is close to it sets the group gap here, so a heading stays visibly with its content.
Section.--c-section-content-gap: Between the parts of a section's content (default space.stack-group).

Grid.--c-grid-aside: The start column's width when ratio is aside, a heading beside its content (default size.column-min, 16rem).

Link.--link-decoration: A link's line at rest: underline (default) or none. With none, the link colour must stand 3:1 from the text around it; the line still shows on hover and keyboard focus. Also the skip link's line (LR7).
Link.--link-decoration-hover: A link's line on hover and keyboard focus: underline (default). Keep it when the rest line is off: it is the cue that isn't colour. Also the hover line of a linked card's title, a page header's eyebrow, an agenda's titles and a board's names, and the skip link's line while it shows (LR7).
Link.--link-color-hover: A plain link's and a Link's colour on hover and keyboard focus (default the link colour, unchanged). A theme that turns the link lines off sets a colour 3:1 from the rest colour, so hover keeps a cue (LR106). Component links (list items, row links, buttons) keep their own states.

Heading.--type-display-size: The display step's size: Hero and page titles, Heading size="display" and Statistic's large value (default text.xxxxl, 3.5rem). A token (var(--text-…)) or a length.
Heading.--type-display-weight: The display step's weight (default weight.bold). Set 400 for a display face that has one weight, so the browser doesn't fake bold.
Heading.--type-display-leading: The display step's line height (default leading.display). A unitless number or a token.
Heading.--type-display-tracking: The display step's letter spacing (default tracking.display). A length in em or a token.
Heading.--type-jumbo-size: The jumbo step's size: Heading size="jumbo" (default text.jumbo, 5rem). Keep it larger than display; settingsCss and applySettings refuse a jumbo smaller than display when both are lengths.
Heading.--type-jumbo-leading: The jumbo step's line height (default leading.display).
Heading.--type-jumbo-tracking: The jumbo step's letter spacing (default tracking.display).

EditorLayout.--c-editor-layout-resize: A resize handle's hit width, centred on the panel's inner edge (default 0.5rem). Set var(--space-4) for an editor whose inspector edge is a wide, quiet strip (LR77).
EditorLayout.--c-editor-layout-resize-line: The line a resize handle shows only while hovered, focused or dragged (default color.focus). Set var(--color-accent) to draw it in the accent (LR77).
EditorLayout.--c-editor-layout-end-inset: The end panel's (an inspector's) padding round its content (default c.editor-layout.inset, as the start panel's). Set var(--space-4) for a docked inspector's room from the window's edge (LR105).
